label: Name a seal
desc: One name, in the roller every player rolls from.
notes: The entry tier. One name, one dollar — priced so it reads as a joke you can afford rather than a purchase.

label: Name seven seals
desc: Seven names. Put a whole pod in there.
notes: Five for seven rather than five for five: the discount is the point, and seven is funnier than five.

label: Name a boss
desc: Prefix and root, on the thing that kills you.
notes: Same price as seven seals on purpose. A boss name is rarer and louder, and pricing the loud thing the same as the bulk thing lets the player pick by taste instead of by cost.

label: Your actual name
desc: Your real, on-the-passport name, as a seal.
notes: The joke tier, and the only one that is really about the money. A hundred dollars to be legally a seal.
